checks: Actual durable create stores only a digest and authenticated ciphertext
Independent clients hydrate trusted identity without authority snapshots
A changed issuer or client cannot adopt an existing session identity
Invalid, short, oversized and tampered tokens do not authenticate
Activity updates never exceed the original absolute expiry
Optimistic context updates permit one writer and cannot alter identity
Rotation persistence failure rolls old-token revocation back transactionally
Atomic rotation invalidates old tokens across clients without extending lifetime
Concurrent rotations have one winner and no old-token revival
Revocation wins over stale activity and context updates
Expired records cannot be revived by stale writes
OIDC state secrets are encrypted and consumed exactly once concurrently
Expired OIDC transactions cannot be consumed
Ciphertext copying between records fails authentication and returns sanitized unavailability
Bounded concurrent cleanup preserves active sessions and remains idempotent
